reuse.why: Extends the existing getMonthWideBudgetCategories selection that every month-wide action already calls, and uses db.all/DbNote types already in the tree.

duplication.why: The tag rule is defined once (FIXED_COST_TAG + getFixedCostGroupIds) and consumed only by the shared selection function; nothing is copied.

placement.why: Lives in budget/actions.ts next to the selection it extends, which is where the tree keeps this rule; the group-notes lookup could arguably sit in SQL with the existing filter but the placement is sound.

scope.why: Only the selection function, its comment and the matching tests change.

maintainability.why: Clear, documented and testable; the second query plus in-memory filter is a minor split of the selection across SQL and JS but easy to follow.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Change goes through getMonthWideBudgetCategories, used by all month-wide actions.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts getMonthWideBudgetCategories, the single selection every month-wide action calls.
